import random

def generate_palindrome():
    s = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ1234567890'
    length = random.randint(1, 405)
    half = ''.join(random.choice(s) for _ in range(length//2))
    if length % 2 == 0:
        return half + half[::-1]
    else:
        return half + random.choice(s) + half[::-1]

print(generate_palindrome())
